content: IBus D-Bus API (verified on target system IBus 1.5.29 + Python prototypes): ibus-daemon listens on dedicated socket, address published in ~/.config/ibus/bus/<machine-id>-unix[-wayland]-<display> files and via 'ibus address'. org.freedesktop.IBus interface at /org/freedesktop/IBus on THAT connection (not session bus - session-bus name only reserved via systemd Type=dbus). No standard introspection data published - hand-coded wire protocol required. Engine service implements org.freedesktop.IBus.Engine methods (ProcessKeyEvent(keyval,keycode,state)->bool, SetSurroundingText, FocusIn/Out, Enable/Disable, Reset, SetCapabilities, SetCursorLocation) and emits signals (CommitText(text as GVariant), ForwardKeyEvent, UpdatePreeditText, DeleteSurroundingText). Component registration via _RegisterComponent over ibus socket; ibus-daemon spawns engine <exec> from component XML on demand, or pre-registered running process works (owner's punto_engine.py and test_shift.py prove both on IBus 1.5.29; test-shift was the active engine during research).
